faq.question: Can several jewelry configurations use one box?
faq.answer: Possibly. Compare each complete configuration against the proposed interior, insert, closure and removal route. Shared packaging or insert components require project-specific confirmation.

faq.question: Is a pull tab or tray stop included?
faq.answer: Neither is confirmed by this concept. State your preferred opening detail and whether a tray stop is needed, then confirm the construction with the relevant supplier.
